WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
total_films AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS film_total
  FROM film_actor
),
shares AS (
  SELECT ac.actor_id, ac.film_count, 1.0 * ac.film_count / tf.film_total AS share
  FROM actor_counts ac
  CROSS JOIN total_films tf
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT s.actor_id, s.film_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share a
ORDER BY s.share - a.avg_share DESC
LIMIT 10
